title: Theo Thinks -50% Then +50% Is Even 😂
description:
Theo's $10,000 fell 50%, then rose 50%, and he's celebrating being back to even. Nora runs the numbers: half of $10,000 is $5,000, and 50% of $5,000 is only $2,500 more. He's sitting at $7,500. Going up first doesn't save him either: $15,000, then half of that, is still $7,500.

Takeaway: a percentage always works on the amount you have right now, so after a 50% drop you need a 100% gain just to get back to where you started.

Did you spot Theo's mistake before Nora did? Be honest 👇

Follow for more numbers that change how you spend.

⚠️ Assumptions: a hypothetical $10,000 and made-up percentage moves to show the maths; ignores fees, dividends and taxes. Not a prediction of any market. Illustration only. This is not financial advice.
